arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: hit_threshold
arg.description: Threshold for the distance between features and SVM classifying plane

arg.name: win_stride
arg.description: Window stride. It must be a multiple of block stride.

arg.name: padding
arg.description: Padding of the detection window in pixels, of cv::HOGDescriptor::detectMultiScale().

arg.name: scale0
arg.description: Coefficient of the detection window increase.

arg.name: group_threshold
arg.description: Coefficient to regulate the similarity threshold. When detected, some objects can be covered by many rectangles. 0 means not to perform grouping.
